independent_review.summary: Static review of the exact two-file Risk package change only. The new package-local snapshot calculation uses a trusted injected facts source, explicit cash+spot coverage, freshness/availability checks, a disclosed Modified Dietz estimate, flow-date FX facts, a fixed Decimal context, and a canonical input digest. It is not a registered analysis worker or an SDK/Host service.

r1.status: preserved diagnostic history; not accepted as the passing run

r2.status: author focused package QA; raw artifacts copied below

limitations: No analysis worker/task adapter or normal SDK/ServiceHost chain.
Cash and spot positions only; derivatives, margin, short inventory, and unsupported asset classes are unavailable.
No policy catalog, limits/cancel integration, or full portfolio analytics metric suite.
Does not satisfy CFG06 or AFI04 and adds no formal PASS.
